worldcombat.skill.wingattack.summary: Spreads both wings wide and sweeps the whole fan in front: the nearest non-allies inside the fan each take one contact hit and are shoved out to the sides. The wide choice is broader, hits up to three and shoves harder but hits lighter; the folded choice is heavier and only sweeps one.
worldcombat.skill.wingattack.use.0: One spread of the wings to sweep a small group in front
worldcombat.skill.wingattack.use.1: Shove a close opponent back to open up a landing spot
worldcombat.skill.wingattack.use.2: A cheap, reliable Flying contact you can throw again and again
worldcombat.skill.wingattack.description: Each swept target takes about %1$s physical contact damage; one spread sweeps at most %2$s non-allies.
The fan reaches %1$s blocks and opens %2$s°; swept targets are shoved %3$s blocks away from the user.
The fan shape is the hit area.
worldcombat.skill.wingattack.wide.on: Wide: a broader fan, up to 3 targets at once and a longer shove; costs power x0.8, wind-up +1 tick and recovery +3 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.wingattack.wide.off: Folded: a heavier single hit (x1.15) that comes out faster; costs sweeping only one target and almost no shove.
worldcombat.skill.wingattack.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.wingattack.growth.0: From level %1$s the sweep power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.wingattack.growth.1: From level %1$s the sweep power rises to %2$s and the sweep length to %3$s blocks.
On: a broader fan, up to 3 targets at once and a longer shove, at the cost of power x0.8, wind-up +1 tick and recovery +3 ticks. Off (folded): a heavier single hit (x1.15) that comes out faster, but it only sweeps one target and barely shoves.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
On: a target packed with more enemies in front ranks higher (the wide sweep clears a patch); off: all targets score the same and only distance matters.
